Mediabunny browser bundle
=========================

Package: mediabunny 1.52.3
Source file: dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs
Local name: mediabunny-renderer.mjs
SHA-256: 558A756CE3B08175145BE6FFE5AAF3EC98EA2AE7302DF8F8D958DBDCA7744FB6
License: MPL-2.0 (see mediabunny-LICENSE.txt)

This directory is required by the high-quality 1080p/2160p renderer.
The game checks the module before opening a save picker and falls back to
MediaRecorder if the module cannot be loaded.
